notes.title: Foreclosed review: a paper-thin cyberpunk stealth shooter
notes.notes:
Greetings Chooms! Cough. Splutter. Sorry, something in my throat. Greetings chums! Please engage your rose-tinted cyber visors, and marvel at a theoretical version of cyberpunk stealth-shooter Foreclosed that’s actually worth playing.

It’s one that abandons weak shooting and focuses on its promising telekinetic powers. That leans into its lead’s latent Max Paynian vulnerability and noir humour instead of joyless, stony disaffect. That realises ‘cyber’ is only as interesting as the lives it affects, and that ‘punk’ can be burlesque eccentricity and burning hopefulness, not just sneering neon. Now, take them off, and let’s take a look at what we’ve actually got here. Oh.

notes.title: Dealing with Shields
notes.notes:
We've seen a couple of way to increase your firepower when needed, today we're going down a similar route but a little more specific.

In FORECLOSED, Evan will sometimes come up against enemies carrying a large shield. They can be tricky to take down, and continue to fire at you from around their protective wall making them a dangerous adversary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/e570542052c30e7c5b7382fe452ff3cd6479a666.gif[/img]

So, what can you?

Sure you can utilise cover and just punch through eventually with sheer force, but there are smarter ways to fight.

The first would be to utilise a mod for the Symbiotic Pistol that will punch right through the pesky shields. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/19fc2a83d3a738080b756707321b75ff489a6d79.gif[/img]

As we know, you don't have free reign to fire away for too long without overheating Evan's implants, but used correctly you'll have the edge you need to take down that shield. You can see the mod activated with a blue flash in-between enemies to denote the Symbiotic Pistiol syncing with Evan's implants and activating any equipped weapon skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/d6b717ba2af0246a33778d738d9d47620a9b5122.gif[/img]

A different way to approach this would be to utilise Evan's implants and use the 'slam' power. Typically Slam will do exaclty what it says on the tin and slam an enemy into the ground, but when used on a shielded enemy it'll rip that shield right out of their hands and leave them vulvernable to your attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/7b11c782b41b5c968cba513e05281f1c8764cc6c.gif[/img]

So when you come up against shield enemies, you'll have a couple fo options at your disposal to deal with them, or you could find your own way through these tricky enemies.

notes.title: When you need more firepower.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to share some combat tips with you today, to show you a couple of different options at your disposal when you need a bit of extra kick in a firefight.

One option is to utilise Evan's experimental implants and to select the telekinesis power. Using telekinesis you can hurl a large object at enemies, sure to take down anyone in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/459d9e670277d7fc1517c4cf1304cc9678b89043.gif[/img]

The added bonus to this is that it also gives Evan some temporary cover, so it's a great tactical manoeuvre to turn the tide of battle!

Another option would be to use Evan's trusty sidearm, the Symbiotic Pistol. On it's own, it's a reliable weapon and reasonably poweful, its real strength though is in the range of upgrades available. You could select and install the machine gun upgrade, and when activated Evan will unleash a storm of bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/5f56636061800c973cf29974bde46a197ccf6f75.gif[/img]

Be careful though, you can't keep the trigger pressed down for too long! The Symbiotic Pistol is directly linked to Evan's implants and prolonged usage will cause them to overheat. If you let that happen then Evan will be totally helpless for a brief time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/c62711bf784c75f7e7706928bdaf9b4b7c53b0d3.gif[/img]

Let us know what approach you prefer!

notes.title: Comics in Context
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we want to talk to you about the comic and graphic novel inspirations that went into FORECLOSED. 
Utilising comic panels the story is delivered in a very seamless way, so the transition from action to story is very smooth and maintains a level of pace that reflects Evan Kapnos’ sense of urgency as he battles to reclaim his ID debt.

There’s a few different ways that we bring the comic book aesthetic into FORECLOSED;
A classic trope of comics is action words & sound effects in big and bold lettering, and we wanted to reflect that in the action sequences of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/6745b8c9cecf23abbc649f52a3186ed18ead72e7.gif[/img]

You’ll find some different action words for different weapon skills to emphasize the variety and different effects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/af1c326443c87659d0797f702ab71380c39aafef.gif[/img]

The story is delivered to the player in a comic panel style that is very engaging. At various points, the player controls Evan through these scenes which bridges the gap between action & story in a very organic way.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HRpwTzY.gif[/img]

The comic book stylings in the action scenes combined with the comic strip story sequences give you a sense of playing through a live graphic novel, we can’t wait to invite you to experience this story for yourself!

notes.title: 5 reasons why we think the Symbiotic Pistol is the coolest sci-fi weapon
notes.notes:
In FORECLOSED, Evan Kapnos is in constant danger with a veritable army of well-armed agents constantly trying to take him down. Fortunately, he has something special to help him fight back, the Symbiotic Pistol. Here’s 5 reasons why we think the Symbiotic Pistol is the coolest sci-fi weapon out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/d2831102d1636f52f5e490e5a1e3dff85fdce5ee.png[/img]

1.	It is unique.
Our hero Evan Kapnos has a truly unique weapon by his side with the only Symbiotic Pistol in existence. There is nothing else like the Symbiotic Pistol and this gives Evan an edge over the forces conspiring against him. 

2.	It needs no ammo.
Evan is always outmanned but never outgunned. The Symbiotic Pistol doesn’t require ammo, so Evan never needs fear that he’ll run out of ammo in the midst of an intense firefight. 

3.	It has multiple uses.
A truly adaptive weapon that can adapt to your play style. Having trouble with shield carrying enemies? There’s an upgrade for that. Need some extra oomph? Load up with exploding bullets and let rip.

4.	It looks cool.
A sleek and exotic take on the standard sidearm, it has an iconic look and perfectly captures the futuristic cyberpunk setting. It’s not just style over substance either, the Symbiotic Pistol delivers in combat.

5.	It is linked directly to our hero
There’s a reason it’s called the Symbiotic Pistol. The weapon links directly to Evan’s implants and creates a unique risk/reward game mechanic where you can balance firepower with the risk of overloading Evan’s implants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/8a22178a7a54456f87d7db1a6d6c36e935018abb.png[/img]

What do you think? Looking forward to getting your hands on the Symbiotic Pistol? Come and let us know on [url=http://discord.gg/mergegames]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Adverts - This time they're personal
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone

Today we’re talking about the world of FORECLOSED, specifically the state of personalised ads when your identity is a commodity, and nothing is off limits.
Near the beginning of our story Kapnos is presented a slew of different adverts when he gets within proximity.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/81h4c3Z.gif[/img]

Proximity triggers are not exactly new for adverts. What’s unique about these is that they’re also personalised. Through a person’s implanted firmware advertisers can address a customer audience individually based on their interests and history. Since his ID has been foreclosed, advertisers can’t address Kapnos directly personally as he (technically) doesn’t exist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/585ba5566fb50bbda5719f97cd39b4ee6768ebbb.jpg[/img]

In our world advertisers can target citizens in several ways including holograms, classic billboards and images projected straight into your brain. Movies like Minority report and Back to the Future 2 have shown similar styles of personalised adverts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/4058677847341f1629e3777ddedf169cbf477cbe.jpg[/img]

In this dystopian setting we wanted to show how advertising can take things to far when given free reign - access to people’s personal information like financial data. Without any checks or balances advertisers may not care how much content you’re exposed to or how frequently.

What do you think of the advertisements in-game? Did we undersell it or do you think the real-world will have far more adverts? Join us on [url=http://discord.gg/mergegames]Discord[/url] and let us know. Add us to your wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1308880/FORECLOSED/]here[/url]

notes.title: FORECLOSED Art Evolution
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re back with another dev diary update! This week we wanted to talk about FORECLOSED’s game art.
FORECLOSED’s main art has gone through a transformation since it’s first reveal announcement in June.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/b1a136b3ab6b72c8ba0887be2fecbf6f42970e9b.png[/img]

During IGN’s Summer of Gaming Showcase. We were overwhelmed with the amount of interest and support FORECLOSED received. 

[previewyoutube=yo8YgdJdHkM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Our first art image we highlighted the main character, (Evan) Kapnos, in the city. We wanted to showcase the vibrant city and the cool tech in the game, both in the character and in the weapon, the Symbiotic Pistol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/d2aa77396c98429d8c4a55ce1a337115cdf37986.png[/img]

We loved the gritty style of this art. But we noticed that people weren’t getting the impression of the game we intended so the art team went back to the drawing board(!) (see what we did there?) to come up with a new style. We wanted to keep the gritty feel and keep Kapnos front and centre as this is his story but we also wanted to highlight the awesome narrative FORECLOSED contains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/d31f02c8dce5c71a539d65352d13e5c6dedf59e7.png[/img]

We’ve come to expect the art team to impress but we were completely blown away with what they delivered! We loved the movie poster style image with some of the story’s main characters featured. We think this gives such a great look into the world of FORECLOSED and hope you do too! Of course, it felt a shame to not utilise the older image, so we’ve kept that as the game’s main menu backdrop, it’s too damn cool to not use it(!) :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1308880/FORECLOSED/

Got any questions about FORECLOSED? What do you think of our new art? Let us know in the comments below. If you haven’t seen it yet, check out the Gamesradar Gameplay interview with FORECLOSED dev team, Antab Studio.

notes.title: What is FORECLOSED?
notes.notes:
Foreclosed is a narrative-driven action-shooter set in a Cyberpunk world. Follow the story of Evan Kapnos in this sleek comic-book styled game and discover how losing your identity is all too possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/26def3fcac7a8b8c60eeca946afb7f4cc46a132b.gif[/img]

FORECLOSED is set in a world where every citizen is born with a debt and accrues more debt through their childhood into adulthood. From education to public transportation, services are added to your identity debt. Citizens must find employers who will buy their “identity debt” and then work for their employer to pay them back. Very few individuals can afford to buy back their identity outright. This is where our hero, Kapnos, comes in, he awakes one morning to discover his employer, Securetech, has gone bankrupt. Kapnos' identity debt has been foreclosed and his identity suspended. This disables his access from the “city blockchain”, everything from utilities in his apartment (he can’t even open his fridge!) to human interaction has been disabled. Kapnos must make it to the courthouse on time to reclaim his identity, but, nothing is ever as easy as it sounds.

[previewyoutube=_LV-hK77zYM;full][/previewyoutube]

FORECLOSED explores the flaws of bureaucratic processes that fail to treat people as individuals. How the act of failing to take the individual into consideration more adversely affects those who are more vulnerable. FORECLOSED’s story is inspired by the developer team’s, (Antab Studio) experiences of failed bureaucratic processes and expands on our world's current dystopian feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/7b75a580ed956edc9de54da423b6b0a245d14156.jpg[/img]

To tell its story FORECLOSED is set within a vivid Cyberpunk world. It’s not just another Cyberpunk game but a game with a real story to tell. Cyberpunk isn’t just about cool tech and futuristic visuals (although it does have that!), it’s about anti-authoritarianism, resisting state suppression and rebellion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/65ba7cd92cbd721aa133bfde1004e2d419bc19e3.gif[/img]

We’re incredibly excited to share Kapnos’ story with you and can’t wait to share more!

notes.title: Foreclosed Music: Hitting the Right Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we're Andrea and Lara from Antab Studio. 
First off, we want to say thanks a ton for your interest in Foreclosed! :)

Today we’d like to talk about something we haven’t have the chance to talk about yet that is an important role in Foreclosed: [b]music[/b]. We're lucky and glad to work with a great composer from Naples, Luigi, who wrote Foreclosed’s main theme and all the other tracks that you will enjoy while following Evan’s story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/7b75a580ed956edc9de54da423b6b0a245d14156.jpg[/img]
[i][b]It all starts with a “A new day”. That’s the name of the song playing at the radio during the “Good morning routine”[/b][/i]

Foreclosed is set in a mature, noir-ish graphic novel, and we really want our ST to be part of the narrative process. 
While we took inspiration from both movies and games and iconic sagas we love, like Deus Ex and Max Payne, a lot of work went into defining the key elements and instruments that describe the world of Foreclosed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/a355bcf30ff270eba11dc381cc0ada71021925b7.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Brainstorming! The main theme is carefully tailored on Evan Kapnos’ story.[/b][/i]

To better describe the world of Foreclosed and the character progression, the music has a balance of classic instruments and electronic elements that changes with the story, representing Evan’s relationship with his implants as he will use them more and more in his adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38022806/c646985c6e160bb4a27b188ba37d8caa09dbdcb1.jpg[/img]
[i][b]A faster pace, powerful drama-drums, and a strong digital vibe: it is time to fight![/b][/i]

We're still working on getting notes just right and we hope to share more about this with you in the future. Thanks for reading!
Lara and Andrea
